must_preserve: Genome size means 1C nuclear DNA amount, not complexity or gene number.
The current largest-record statement is Tmesipteris oblanceolata at 160.45 Gbp/1C, superseding Paris japonica as the record holder.
No single universal genome-size mechanism is assumed.
All results are conditional future outputs; observed_results is empty.
No acknowledgments, author, affiliation, funding, or thanks blocks.
risk_language: The report must distinguish mechanism evidence from local effect, trait causality, or a measured evolutionary outcome.
